about_the_game:
Enter the Spire Of Terrors

Sin Spire is an erotic horror game set in a large procedural set of dungeons that guarantee surprises around every corner. In Sin Spire, you play as a nameless wanderer, who must escape a dark alternate dimension where unspeakable horrors lurk. Your only hope is to brave the Spire and purify the malevolent spirits trapped within.

Features

  • A 6th generation inspired retro style

  • 5 thematically unique procedural dungeons with Stalkers that chase you down

  • A varied cast of terrifying 'monster girls' which have sexual interactions and voice acting

  • Dynamic in-game first/third person sex sequences

  • Alternate game-modes, skill progression and more!

Retro Horror Erotica

Stylistically inspired by the 6th generation of video games, Sin Spire utilizes a retro style to evoke a sense of the uncanny and creating a strangely nostalgic and warped atmosphere. 

Fight, hide or run as you encounter a cast of unique female enemies, each presenting a distinct threat. Purchase weapons, gear and upgrades to defend yourself against these petrifying ladies before they have their way with you.

Sexual Purification

Never leave the perspective of your character as you experience fully animated sex sequences that integrate themselves into the game world. Manage your stats to make sure you’re not putting yourself in danger and use your sexual blessings to purify the monsters within the Spire.

Are you ready to brave the Spire and face the terrors within?

You play as a nameless wanderer who must defend himself against a large cast of female monsters. Engage in horrific yet erotic encounters and do your best to escape the Spire.
